stage: Research packet design; no new production effect inspected
principle: Account for every principal claim without turning a multidimensional grid or theoretical proposition into an invented scalar. Do not substitute illustrative cells for the full-grid verdict.
headline_rows: All26 source-audited principal claims remain represented. Nonscalar or unavailable comparisons retain explicit reasons and not-established magnitude; complete component contrasts remain in the packet and supporting tables.

selection_provenance: The same cells were fixed by the existing production report-builder plan before new-production effect inspection. This record maps them to the v2 first-page contract; it does not change any experimental or inferential plan.
rendering_requirement: Show signed scientific effects, units, positive meaning, justified pre-production extraction tolerance and separate direction. Source extraction bounds are not source printed decimal precision or equivalence margins.
limitations: No values, magnitude labels, direction labels or scientific verdicts are assigned in this design record. A finite point estimate does not automatically resolve a source estimand or unstable estimate.
